question: Which country topped the Global Digital Well-Being Index with the highest score in online safety and parental support?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India topped the Global Digital Well-Being Index with a score of 67 out of 100, excelling in online safety and parental support.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India ranked first in online satisfaction, with 58% of respondents content with their digital experiences.**
 
• **India had the strongest support networks, with young people having 9-12 sources of guidance, including parents and teachers.**
 
• **Parental engagement increased, with 70% of parents regularly monitoring their teens' online activities, up from 62% in 2023.**
 
• **Despite its ranking, India also reported high rates of online threats, including sextortion and grooming.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Online Safety Ranking**__: India outperformed the US (53%) and the UK (42%) in digital satisfaction.
 
• __**Online Threats**__: 71% of Gen Z users in India reported sextortion cases, with 55% falling victim.
 
• __**Legal Awareness**__: 52% of respondents wrongly believed that not reporting explicit content involving minors was legal.
 
• __**Digital Engagement**__: The rise in parental oversight and support networks reflects India's efforts toward safer digital experiences.
